content: Repo lints with Biome, not ESLint. Any '// eslint-disable-next-line' comment found in src/ is stale tooling cruft from a pre-Biome era — delete it rather than keep it (warren-1d4c, gh #541).

renderError(err, requestId?) in src/server/errors.ts: only WarrenError subclasses + backend code-passthrough keep their message on the wire; anything else gets INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE plus the correlation id in hint. errorLogFields(err) carries message+stack to pino at the catch sites.

title: 500 correlation id rides in envelope hint
rationale: Keeps ErrorEnvelope {code,message,hint?} and the openapi/UI/client types unchanged while still exposing the id in the body

content: New /readyz wire-level tests go in src/server/handlers/diagnostics.*.test.ts, not src/server/server.test.ts which sits ~4 lines under its check:size budget.

title: Preview login is a bearer-gated POST
rationale: Removes the token-in-URL credential leak and the isAuthExempt carve-out; the route is gated like every other /runs/*

content: RouteContext.clientIp is optional, populated from Bun.serve's server.requestIP; prefer X-Forwarded-For's first hop over the socket peer since the canonical deploy fronts warren with Caddy / an Ingress; fall back to a shared 'unknown' bucket.

title: Stream capacity is 503 + Retry-After, not 429
rationale: A finite resource is exhausted rather than a caller exceeding a request budget; only a dedicated renderError branch can emit response headers

name: auth-actor-seam
description: Auth actor seam (warren-1ff0): AuthOk carries an Actor (kind + ActorCapabilities flags), server.ts threads it onto optional RouteContext.actor; flags are named for the permission, mirroring RuntimeCapabilities, so consumers branch on capability not identity.

content: RouteContext.actor is undefined exactly on isAuthExempt paths (/healthz, /version, non-API) because the auth gate never runs there — same optional-field precedent as clientIp.

name: boot-resolved-provider-registry
description: Boot-resolved provider registries in warren follow src/runtime/registry.ts: KINDS array + DEFAULT_*_KIND + resolve*Kind(env) trimming the raw value, blank → default, unknown → a WarrenError subclass with a recovery hint naming the valid values.

title: WARREN_AUTH=public wraps bearer auth rather than replacing it
rationale: An Authorization header is always held to the token (401 on mismatch); only its absence mints the anonymous actor. WARREN_API_TOKEN stays required so public mode never removes the operator's way in.

content: New capability-narrowed actors are frozen module constants in src/server/auth.ts (OPERATOR_ACTOR, ANONYMOUS_ACTOR) with a matching frozen AuthOk; ActorKind is the discriminant union that widens with each provider.
Route policy lives on ROUTE_TABLE/Route as a required RoutePolicy field; handleRequest in src/server/server.ts is the only enforcement site — never add a capability check inside a handler.
isAuthExempt is derived from the anonymous-policy ROUTE_TABLE entries (only static, param-free patterns qualify); anonymous is strictly wider than readPublic (no gate at all, in every auth mode).

title: GET /runs/:id/inbox is readOperator because it mutates on read
rationale: The inbox route claims unread rows on read (destructive), not merely a disclosure concern — asserted by a dedicated non-drain test in runs.inbox.test.ts.

name: public-response-projection-allowlist
description: Public response projection is allowlist-only: pickFields(row, PUBLIC_*_FIELDS) in src/server/projection.ts, with the operator body derived from the same value so the two can never drift. isPublicOnly(actor) keys on capabilities.readOperator, never actor.kind; absent actor ⇒ operator.

content: Classify every column of a projected table into exported PUBLIC/REDACTED lists and assert their union against getTableColumns() — adding a column then fails the test until someone classifies it.

title: workerId redacted alongside burrowId/burrowRunId
rationale: Same internal-handle class, always NULL on new rows, already absent from the SDK RunRow wire type — redacted even though pl-b82d's seed text named only the two burrow ids. warren-c405's acceptance scenario must include workerId in its redacted-field list.

name: public-redacted-field-pair-per-surface
description: Public projections export a PUBLIC_*/REDACTED_* 'as const satisfies readonly (keyof T)[]' pair per surface; a test asserts the union partitions the operator shape so a new field fails until classified.

title: Hoist safe facts out of free-form blobs rather than narrowing in place
rationale: When a redacted field is a free-form blob (agents.renderedJson), hoist the named safe facts (description/provider/model) onto the row for both audiences rather than narrowing the blob in place — narrowing a free-form bag is a denylist.

content: Nested response shapes need one allowlist per nesting level (body / totals / group buckets); a single top-level pick silently ships nested secrets.

Event kind is an OPEN string (runtime/contract.ts §6.6), so the event projection is the one place the allowlist-never-denylist rule in src/server/projection.ts is deliberately inverted — an allowlist would swallow the transcript on the next burrow bump; the payload scrubber runs regardless of kind so an unclassified kind is scrubbed, not trusted.

name: row-redaction-implies-event-redaction
description: A field redacted from a row projection must also be dropped from any event payload that echoes it (burrowId/burrowRunId → drop the bridge_* kinds), or the transcript hands back what the row projection withholds.

name: streaming-projection-drop-channel
description: Streaming projections need a drop channel: encode returns string | null and asNdjsonStream's pull loops to the next item — enqueuing an empty chunk would put a blank line on the NDJSON wire.

title: Org allowlist proves the org offline, not per-repo visibility
rationale: A forge API call per registration would put a network dependency on POST /projects and on boot; instead WARREN_PUBLIC_ORG_ALLOWLIST + 'only list orgs whose repos you'd publish'. Rationale in src/server/public-allowlist.ts module header.

content: Public-mode config is resolved at the TOP of bootServer (authKind + allowlist) so misconfiguration refuses before the db opens; only the provider construction stays late, where serverConfig.token is known.

name: no-injectable-clone-seam-test-pattern
description: POST /projects clones with defaultSpawn, not deps.spawn, so there is no injectable clone seam: prove 'got past the gate' by pre-inserting the row and asserting addProject's duplicate message, and prove 'nothing cloned' with a mkdtemp projects root asserted still empty.

title: GET /whoami is readPublic, never anonymous
rationale: An anonymous-policy route is auth-exempt, so RouteContext.actor is undefined and the route cannot report the caller's identity — the policy that makes an identity endpoint work is the narrower one.

description: New API routes touch API_PREFIXES in handlers/index.ts, the mirrored WARREN_API_PATH_PREFIXES in src/preview/proxy/route-match.ts, and SPECTATOR_ROUTES in handlers/index.test.ts when policy is readPublic.
resolution: Update all three; the warren-api-prefixes-stay-in-sync test catches the proxy mirror, the spectator sweep catches the third.

description: GET /plan-runs/:id is readPublic but returned raw RunRows from runs.listByIds — a second construction site for run rows bypassed projectRun entirely, leaking renderedAgentJson/workerId/burrowId anonymously.
resolution: projectRun exported from handlers/runs/lifecycle.ts and applied in getPlanRunHandler; rule: any handler that fans out rows another route projects must reuse that projection.

description: defaultSpawn's three copies justify themselves with a false comment: 'so neither surface imports the other'
resolution: All three copies already import resolveSpawnEnv from src/projects/clone.ts, so the stated rationale does not hold — the surfaces are already coupled through that import. warren-032a should delete the comment along with the duplicate copies rather than preserving the reasoning.

title: ServerDeps carries boot-derived persistence seams; handlers never build a repo from deps.db
rationale: Building a repo from deps.db per request coupled the HTTP surface to the persistence layer and was one of the six real layering violations this gate found.

name: caught-error-body-log-split
description: Errors caught and reported inside a 2xx body need the same body/log split as thrown ones
CanopyUnavailableError messages interpolate cn/git stderr and on-disk paths, so renderError's 'typed error is vetted' rule does not hold for the registry error family
resolution: Do not assume a typed WarrenError subclass carries a safe message. warren-924b and warren-f7c6 track the two remaining live leaks (renderError's 503 branch, and RefreshSkipped.reason). Audit any typed error whose message is built by interpolating subprocess output or a filesystem path before trusting it on the wire.

content: errorCode() now accepts only identifier-shaped codes (/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$/i). Redacting message while copying code verbatim off a caught error leaves the same leak through a narrower hole, since nothing constrains what a thrown object puts in .code.

description: Scenario 39's stream-cap probe held its slots as follow=1 tails on the SEEDED TERMINAL run — which only worked because pre-warren-7bff terminal follow tails dangled forever. When 7bff added the terminal backstop (follow tails close right after replay on terminal runs), the held streams released their slots and the 3rd probe got 200 instead of 503. A seeded RUNNING run is no fix: bootBridges pre-probes each active run and reconciles a clean provider 404 to failed/burrow_run_lost, so any seeded running row dies at boot in the in-proc acceptance stack.
resolution: PR #699: pin the cap probe on the plan-run events tail — tailPlanRunEvents with follow=1 parks until client disconnect regardless of plan state, and it shares the same EventStreamLimiter as the run route.

name: event-scrubber-operator-vs-spectator
description: Live-testing the event-stream secret scrubber (warren-6fa0): projectEvent in src/server/handlers/runs/event-projection.ts returns the RAW row to any authenticated caller by design — scrubbing only applies to the public/spectator projection. To verify redaction on a live public-mode instance, fetch GET /runs/:id/events WITHOUT a bearer token; the operator stream will always show secrets in the clear.

name: security-headers-seam
description: Baseline security headers (CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, frame-ancestors, HSTS) live as SECURITY_HEADERS in src/server/response.ts and are merged by jsonResponse/ndjsonResponse/textResponse and the UI file server; API bodies also emit Vary: Authorization via the same mergeHeaders seam (explicit handler headers win). Scenario 39 asserts both on every public GET.
warren-46a7: per-client event-stream cap keyed off left-most X-Forwarded-For, which GCLB lets the client set — one source could rotate the header and drain the 200-slot global stream budget.
resolution: Count XFF from the right, skipping WARREN_EVENT_STREAM_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS infrastructure hops (GKE overlay pins 1 for GCLB's own address); short chains fall back to the socket peer.
